Note that for UVP5, in Barth and Stone (2022), they removed the bottom 50m of each profile because they observed that the slowing of the CTD-rosette leads to high potential reimaging of particles.


Taks after discussion with Zoe:
1. Remove outlier profiles with distinct influence of the nepheloid layers (or advection) that limits the POC flux estimation. [identified the stations to exclude for the 200m and 500m levels]
2. Calculate the minimum POC flux at 500m (export to diapausing depth). [The sample sizes decrease because fewer profiles are considered. Generally POC flux decreases for all regions, except in Nunatsiavut and Qikiqtaaluk shelves wherein the POC flux increases... possibly due to nepheloid layers increasing particle counts, note sample sizes are only n = 2-3]
3. Calculate the daily lipid pump C flux (/365 days) vs daily POC flux... then calculate a major axis regression? [This does not change the relative location of the regional means but it does shift the positions relative to the 1:1 line towards the POC flux side, since the comparison is between the summer average POC flux vs the annual average lipid pump C flux.]

4. Use an objective averaging of the literature sediment trap flux to get the conversion factor between summer and winter. [Need to properly extract data from the figures]
- Need to digitize figures from Sampei et al. (2004) and Lalande et al. (2009)... results of 6 stations: summer to winter conversion factor is 0.25!

5. Calculate % detritus from the 2021 and 2023 fully validated ecotaxa data + include appendicularian houses... assign them to size classes based on ESD (major-minor average?) ... >80-90?
2024: 
2023: (1392765+73769+36170+4137+1999+747+210+185)/1671362
2021: (1072077+153923+51+3431)/1520846

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


Steps:
1. Remove POC for depth bins 50m from the bottom depth.
2. Calculate POC flux for each profile and 5m bin.
3. Calculate the average POC flux exported beyond the epipelagic (200m) and beyond 500m which is diapause depth. Outlier profiles with distinct nepheloid layer influence are excluded either for the 200m and 500m are excluded.
4. Estimate the annual flux from the daily flux.


# Literature POC flux
## Ranges of values in study area
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
theme_set(theme_bw())

sedTrap <- read.csv("data/Sediment_trap_literature_20260328.csv") %>% 
  filter(Daily_Flux < 7000) %>% 
  mutate(Annual_Flux = as.numeric(Annual_Flux),
         Daily_Flux = as.numeric(Daily_Flux))

cowplot::plot_grid( ggplot(sedTrap %>% 
                             filter(MonthCode == "Annual") %>% 
                             filter(!is.na(Annual_Flux)), 
                           aes(y = Depth_m, x = Annual_Flux,
                               color = AreaCode)) +
                      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
                      scale_y_reverse() +
                      xlab("Annual POC flux (g C m-2 y-1)"),
                    
                    ggplot(sedTrap, 
                           aes(y = Depth_m, x = Daily_Flux)) +
                      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
                      scale_y_reverse() +
                      xlab("Daily POC flux (mg C m-2 d-1)"),
                    rel_widths = c(1.5,1))


ggplot(sedTrap %>% 
         filter(MonthCode == "Annual") %>% 
         filter(!is.na(Annual_Flux)), 
       aes(x = AreaCode, y = Annual_Flux)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  ylab("Annual POC flux (g C m-2 y-1)")


sed.trap.NOW <- sedTrap %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Annual_Flux)) %>% 
  filter(AreaCode %in% c("NOW")) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_Bin = if_else(Depth_m < 260, "200m", "300-500m"))

summary(sed.trap.NOW$Annual_Flux)
sd(sed.trap.NOW$Annual_Flux)
summary(sed.trap.NOW$Depth_m)
```


# UVP6 POC flux calculation
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
theme_set(theme_bw())

load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
load("data/profile_integrated_cflux_20260321.RData")
load("data/POC_flux_UVP6_confident_20260329.RData")

clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

# Outlier profiles to exclude
to_exclude_200 <- c("AC20 2023","NaresW23 2023","NaresE23 2023",
                "RA38 2024", "RA06 2024", "RA07 2024", "RA08 2024", "RA31 2024",
                "RA42 2024", "RA43 2024", "RA73 2024", "Kangalasiorvik Shelf 2024",
                "TCA-QFA1 2024", "de500 2021",
                "keb_S05 2024","RA72 2024","RA02 2024","RA52 2024")

to_exclude_500 <- c("RA46 2024", "RA48 2024", "RA50 2024", "RA45 2024",
                    "TCAT6-03(A3) 2024", "129 2023",
                    "Sentinel 2024", "LSea-23 2023")

# Calculate POC flux per station_year profile
pocFlux_station_year <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
  # Only include the profiles used in the lipid pump analysis
  filter(sample_id %in% Amund_UVP6_meta$sample_id) %>% 
  # Merge replicated profiles at the same station
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year, 
                     bottom_depth_m, Month, reg.inuk),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  select(-c(sample_id, project, date, time)) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_5m, Month, reg.inuk) %>% 
  # Average all variables per 5m bin
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Exclude depth bins 50 m  above the bottom depth (Barth and Stone 2022)
  filter(Depth_5m <= bottom_depth_m-50)

# Calculate POC flux at 200 m (+- 25m)
pocFlux.ave.200 <- pocFlux_station_year %>% 
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_200) %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= 175 & Depth_5m < 225) %>% 
  # calculate the total flux per profile
  group_by(station_year, bottom_depth_m, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            poc_mgC_m2_d = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Estimate the annual flux (winter:summer conversion factor of 0.25)
  mutate(poc_gC_m2_yr = (poc_mgC_m2_d + 0.25*poc_mgC_m2_d)/2 *365 /1000) %>% 
  
  # Nares strait has shorter productive period (June-September)
  mutate(poc_gC_m2_yr_nares = (poc_mgC_m2_d*122 + 0.25*poc_mgC_m2_d*243) /1000)

# Calculate POC flux at 500 m (+- 25m)
pocFlux.ave.500 <- pocFlux_station_year %>% 
  filter(station_year %notin% to_exclude_500) %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= 475 & Depth_5m < 525) %>% 
  # calculate the total flux per profile
  group_by(station_year, bottom_depth_m, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            poc_mgC_m2_d = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Estimate the annual flux (winter:summer conversion factor of 0.25)
  mutate(poc_gC_m2_yr = (poc_mgC_m2_d + 0.25*poc_mgC_m2_d)/2 *365 /1000)%>% 
  
  # Nares strait has shorter productive period (June-September)
  mutate(poc_gC_m2_yr_nares = (poc_mgC_m2_d*122 + 0.25*poc_mgC_m2_d*243) /1000)


ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = pocFlux.ave.200, 
               aes(x = reg.inuk, y = poc_mgC_m2_d, color = reg.inuk),
               position = position_nudge(x = -0.2)) +
  # geom_boxplot(data = pocFlux.ave.500, 
  #              aes(x = reg.inuk, y = poc_mgC_m2_d),
  #              alpha = 0.5, color = "black",
  #              position = position_nudge(x = 0.2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  ggtitle("Daily POC flux")
```

```{r}
df.meta.depths <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
  distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T)  %>%

            mean_bottom = mean(bottom_depth_m),
            sd_bottom = sd(bottom_depth_m),
            .groups = "drop") 

region_pocFlux <- pocFlux_station_year %>% 
  filter(station_year %in% pocFlux.ave.200$station_year) %>%
  # limit the mean+sd bottom depth
  left_join(df.meta.depths, by = join_by(reg.inuk)) %>%

  group_by(reg.inuk, Depth_5m) %>% 
  summarise(daily_poc_mgC_m2_d = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            daily_poc_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            n5mbins = n(),
            .groups = "drop")
  

# Separate 2 rows of regions
upperplot <- c("NarSt","Pikia","TalIm")

g2 <- ggplot() +

ggsave("figures/Supp_region_POC_flux_20260511.png",

# TODO only select profiles used in the LPC vs POC fluxc comparison?

  scale_x_reverse(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,500)) +
```

## Prepare comparisons
```{r}
pocFlux.region.200 <- pocFlux.ave.200 %>% 
  mutate(poc_gC_m2_yr = if_else(reg.inuk == "NarSt",
                                poc_gC_m2_yr_nares, poc_gC_m2_yr)) %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(poc_gC_m2_yr_mean = mean(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_gC_m2_yr_sd = sd(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_mean = mean(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

pocFlux.region.500 <- pocFlux.ave.500 %>% 
  mutate(poc_gC_m2_yr = if_else(reg.inuk == "NarSt",
                                poc_gC_m2_yr_nares, poc_gC_m2_yr)) %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(poc_gC_m2_yr_mean = mean(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_gC_m2_yr_sd = sd(poc_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_mean = mean(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            poc_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(poc_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Pairwise matching of POC flux and lipid flux
lipid.Cflux.profile.200 <- df.profile %>% 
  filter(station_year %in% pocFlux.ave.200$station_year) %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  rename(lipid_gC_m2_yr = total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  select(reg.inuk, station_year, lipid_gC_m2_yr) %>% 
  # calculate daily flux
  mutate(lipid_mgC_m2_d = lipid_gC_m2_yr/365 * 1000) 
  
lipid.Cflux.region.200 <- lipid.Cflux.profile.200 %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean = mean(lipid_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            lipid_gC_m2_yr_sd = sd(lipid_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            lipid_mgC_m2_d_mean = mean(lipid_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            lipid_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(lipid_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

lipid.Cflux.profile.500 <- df.profile %>% 
  filter(station_year %in% pocFlux.ave.500$station_year) %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  rename(lipid_gC_m2_yr = total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  select(reg.inuk, station_year, lipid_gC_m2_yr) %>% 
  # calculate daily flux
  mutate(lipid_mgC_m2_d = lipid_gC_m2_yr/365 * 1000) 
  
lipid.Cflux.region.500 <- lipid.Cflux.profile.500 %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean = mean(lipid_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            lipid_gC_m2_yr_sd = sd(lipid_gC_m2_yr, na.rm = T),
            lipid_mgC_m2_d_mean = mean(lipid_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            lipid_mgC_m2_d_sd = sd(lipid_mgC_m2_d, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")


```

## Compare POC flux and lipid pump carbon flux
Compare for both daily and annual flux, at 200 m and 500 m
```{r}
# Combine for comparisons
flux.comp.200 <- left_join(lipid.Cflux.region.200, pocFlux.region.200,
                           by = join_by(reg.inuk, n))
flux.comp.500 <- left_join(lipid.Cflux.region.500, pocFlux.region.500,
                           by = join_by(reg.inuk, n))

flux.com.profiles.200 <- left_join(lipid.Cflux.profile.200,
                                   pocFlux.ave.200,
                                   by = join_by(reg.inuk, station_year))
flux.com.profiles.500 <- left_join(lipid.Cflux.profile.500,
                                   pocFlux.ave.500,
                                   by = join_by(reg.inuk, station_year))


# Pairwise comparisons
# Compare daily
ggplot(flux.comp.200, 
       aes(x = lipid_mgC_m2_d_mean, y = poc_mgC_m2_d_mean,
           color = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_abline() +
  # the individual profiles
  geom_point(data = flux.com.profiles.200,
             aes(x = lipid_mgC_m2_d, y = poc_mgC_m2_d),
             alpha = 0.4) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lipid_mgC_m2_d_mean-lipid_mgC_m2_d_sd,
                    xmax = lipid_mgC_m2_d_mean+lipid_mgC_m2_d_sd),
                width = 0) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = poc_mgC_m2_d_mean-poc_mgC_m2_d_sd,
                    ymax = poc_mgC_m2_d_mean+poc_mgC_m2_d_sd),
                width = 0) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1, size = 6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,100,5), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,100,5), expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 35), ylim = c(0, 95)) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region", guide = "none")  +
  
  xlab("Lipid pump (mg C m⁻² d⁻¹)")+
  ylab("POC flux (mg C m⁻² d⁻¹)")
```

# Stat tests
```{r}
# two-sided Wilcoxon signed rank test
results.200 <- flux.com.profiles.200 %>%
  mutate(POC_Flux = poc_gC_m2_yr, LipidC_Flux = lipid_gC_m2_yr) %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    median_FluxA = median(POC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_FluxB = median(LipidC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_diff = median(LipidC_Flux - POC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    wilcox_obj = list(wilcox.test(POC_Flux, LipidC_Flux, 
                                  paired = TRUE)),
    
    V = wilcox_obj[[1]]$statistic,
    p_value = wilcox_obj[[1]]$p.value,
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  select(-wilcox_obj) %>% 
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% 
  mutate(is_sig = if_else(p_adj < 0.05, T, F))

results.200 %>% 
  arrange(p_adj) %>% 
  relocate(is_sig, p_adj, median_diff) 

results.500 <- flux.com.profiles.500 %>%
  mutate(POC_Flux = poc_gC_m2_yr, LipidC_Flux = lipid_gC_m2_yr) %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    median_FluxA = median(POC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_FluxB = median(LipidC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_diff = median(LipidC_Flux - POC_Flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    wilcox_obj = list(wilcox.test(POC_Flux, LipidC_Flux, 
                                  paired = TRUE)),
    
    V = wilcox_obj[[1]]$statistic,
    p_value = wilcox_obj[[1]]$p.value,
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  select(-wilcox_obj) %>% 
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% 
  mutate(is_sig = if_else(p_adj < 0.05, T, F))

results.500 %>% 
  arrange(p_adj) %>% 
  relocate(is_sig, p_adj, median_diff) 
```

## Identifying outlier profiles 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
load("data/POC_flux_UVP6_confident_20260326.RData")


pocFlux_station_year <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
    # Apply the correction in Barth and Stone (2022) wherein the bottom 50 m of each profile was removed due to observed high reimaging of particles as the UVP6 slows down.
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(maxSampleDepth = max(Depth_5m)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  filter(sample_id %in% Amund_UVP6_meta$sample_id) %>% 
  # merge to station-year
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year, 
                     bottom_depth_m, Year, Month, reg.inuk),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  select(-c(sample_id, project, date, time)) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_5m, Month, reg.inuk) %>% 
  # Average all variables per 5m layer
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Exclude 50 meters from bottom
  filter(Depth_5m <= (bottom_depth_m-50))
```

## Compare UVP5 and UVP6 Annual POC flux estimates
```{r}
load("data/UVP5_CA_Arctic_POCFLUX_results_20260329.RData")

# Filter profiles
pocFlux_UVP5_profiles <- pocFlux_UVP5 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(ModelFlux)) %>% 
  left_join(UVP5_region %>% 
            select(Profile, Date_Time, region.inuktitut),
            by = "Profile") %>% 
  left_join(UVP5_CA_Arctic_meta %>% 
              select(Profile, Deepest_Bin), by = "Profile") %>% 
  
  # TODO try to remove benthic nephroid layer?
   # consider only stations with at least 300m depth?
  filter(Deepest_Bin >= 300) %>% 
  mutate(Month = month(Date_Time)) %>% 
  filter(Month != 3)  %>% 
   # consider only stations with at least 250m depth?
  filter(Depth_5m >= 150 & Depth_5m < 250) %>% 
  
    # calculate the total flux per profile
  group_by(Profile, Deepest_Bin, Month, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            poc_model = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_model_sd = sd(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  mutate(poc_model_se = poc_model_sd / sqrt(n5mbins)) %>% 
  
  # Convert to annual flux... 
  mutate(poc_model_365 = (poc_model * 182.5 / 1000) + (poc_model/4 * 182.5 / 1000)) 

  
  # Region-average comparison
pocFlux_UVP5_region <- pocFlux_UVP5_profiles %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(UVP5_n = n(),
            UVP5_poc_model_365_mean = mean(poc_model_365),

            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(UVP5_poc_model_365_se = UVP5_poc_model_365_sd / sqrt(UVP5_n)) %>% 
  # remove Nares Strait data because seems anomalous
  filter(region.inuktitut != "Nares Strait")
```

```{r}
# TODO for SanIm and QikIk: Calculate transfer efficiency (fraction of POC flux leaving euphotic that reaches the bottom of the mesophotic)
TEff_flux <- pocFlux.ave.depths %>% 
  filter(bottom_depth_m > 1000) %>% 
  filter(Depth_layer %in% c(200,500,1000)) %>%
  select(-n5mbins) %>% 
  select(station_year:poc_model) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_layer = paste0("D_",Depth_layer)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Depth_layer, values_from = poc_model) %>% 
  mutate(TEff_200_1000 = (D_200 - D_1000) / D_200) %>% 
  mutate(TEff_200_500 = (D_200 - D_500) / D_200)

# Seems like SanIm (Baffin Bay) has higher POC flux transfer efficiency as QikIk (Davis Strait). The negative Teff might indicate the benthic nephloid layer particles.

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = TEff_200_1000)) +

             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c()

# TODO calculate Martin's b with powerlaw decay for all profiles
zref <- 100 # reference depth

pocFlux.martin <- pocFlux_station_year %>% 
  filter(bottom_depth_m >= 300) %>% 
  select(station_year, reg.inuk, Depth_5m, ModelFlux) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_5m = Depth_5m - 2.5) %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= zref) %>% 
  # log transform for the log-linear fits
  mutate(x = log(Depth_5m / zref),
         y = log(ModelFlux)) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, reg.inuk) %>%  
  summarise(b = {mod <- lm(y ~ x)
  -coef(mod)[["x"]]}   ) %>%  # TODO sort the significant regressions only
  ungroup()
 

# Martin's b: b > 0 (attenuate with depth)... higher b means faster attenuation
# b < 0 (flux increases with depth)... either meaningful or because nephloid not properly removed
ggplot(pocFlux.martin, aes(x = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = b, color = reg.inuk)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color))
```
